'''Lennar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. Mangy and scarred, Lennar considered himself to be a ladies man, but was in truth repulsive, overbearing, and incompetent.
